human.summary: Adaptable people with a flexible skill and origin-feature choice.

drow.summary: Drow lineage grants darkvision and a small set of innate spells.

high_elf.summary: High elf lineage grants a wizard cantrip and additional innate magic.

wood_elf.summary: Wood elf lineage grants increased speed and nature magic.

elf.summary: A long-lived people with keen senses, darkvision, fey ancestry, and trance.

dwarf.summary: A sturdy people with poison resilience, extra vitality, and stone sense.

halfling.summary: A small, nimble people known for luck and courage.

forest.summary: Forest lineage grants a cantrip and limited animal speech magic.

rock.summary: Rock lineage grants two cantrips and the ability to make a clockwork device.

gnome.summary: A small people with darkvision, magical resilience, and a supernatural lineage.

goliath.summary: A giant-descended people with powerful physical traits and an ancestry boon.

cloud.summary: Cloud giant ancestry grants a brief teleport.

fire.summary: Fire giant ancestry empowers a damaging strike.

frost.summary: Frost giant ancestry slows a creature with a chilling blow.

hill.summary: Hill giant ancestry can knock a creature prone.

stone.summary: Stone giant ancestry helps blunt incoming damage.

storm.summary: Storm giant ancestry answers injury with thunder.

orc.summary: A durable people who can surge forward and endure a decisive blow.

infernal.summary: Infernal legacy grants fire resistance and related innate magic.

abyssal.summary: Abyssal legacy grants poison resistance and related innate magic.

chthonic.summary: Chthonic legacy grants necrotic resistance and related innate magic.

tiefling.summary: A fiend-touched people with darkvision and a chosen supernatural legacy.

black.summary: Black dragon ancestry grants acid resistance and a matching breath weapon.

blue.summary: Blue dragon ancestry grants lightning resistance and a matching breath weapon.

brass.summary: Brass dragon ancestry grants fire resistance and a matching breath weapon.

bronze.summary: Bronze dragon ancestry grants lightning resistance and a matching breath weapon.

copper.summary: Copper dragon ancestry grants acid resistance and a matching breath weapon.

gold.summary: Gold dragon ancestry grants fire resistance and a matching breath weapon.

green.summary: Green dragon ancestry grants poison resistance and a matching breath weapon.

red.summary: Red dragon ancestry grants fire resistance and a matching breath weapon.

silver.summary: Silver dragon ancestry grants cold resistance and a matching breath weapon.

white.summary: White dragon ancestry grants cold resistance and a matching breath weapon.

dragonborn.summary: A draconic people with a chosen elemental ancestry and breath weapon.

half-breed.summary: Choose two parent species; this custom ancestry is outside SRD 5.2.1.
